name.en: Ayutthaya weekend by car or scooter

tagline.en: Two days: palace, ruins by the river, one night in the old capital, back for Sunday dinner.

why.en: Pick up the car or scooter early. The expressway north is quiet before 8:00.
First break after the city traffic.

stops.note: Placeholder: pick a real cafe on the content pass.

why.en: The summer palace: Thai, Chinese and European pavilions around a lake. One hour is enough.
The riverside ruin from the postcards. Best light an hour before sunset.

stops.note: Placeholder: a mid-range riverside stay on the island. Real pick on the content pass.

why.en: Three chedis of the old royal temple. Go at opening, before the tour buses.
The Buddha head in the tree roots. Five minutes by scooter from Si Sanphet.

stops.note: Placeholder: name the stall on the content pass.
Placeholder cafe south of the island, before the highway.

why.en: Aim to be on the expressway by 16:00 to miss the Sunday return traffic.
